continuation_context.subtlety: The (a,b) from buchiFamily_cover is NOT automatically the recurrent prefix-class. Prefix class after f(k) symbols is ⟦xl ++ blocks⟧ = a · b^k in the syntactic monoid. For b ∈ infOcc one needs idempotent structure (b·b=b, a·b=a) so prefix classes stabilize and the relevant recurrent class actually appears infinitely often in the run. This idempotent/recurrence layer is the missing infrastructure.
